label.en: Document and study the sanitary infrastructure.

利用这个无人机的科技。
注入病毒瘫痪这个清洁网络。
label.en: Engineer a virus to disable the sanitation network.

label.zh: 让这台无人机充当个人研究助理。
label.en: Keep this drone as a personal research assistant.

取回那个鸟类然后研究研究这里发生了什么。
label.en: Retrieve the avian and determine what happened here.

label.zh: 利用这个无人机的科技。
注入病毒瘫痪这个清洁网络。
label.en: Engineer a virus to disable the sanitation network.

label.zh: 让这台无人机充当个人研究助理。
label.en: Keep this drone as a personal research assistant.

label.zh: 记录并研究这个清洁基础设施。
label.en: Document and study the sanitary infrastructure.

texts.zh:
这颗行星的大气中含有数量惊人的抗菌剂。

传感器显示附近没有任何有机生命的迹象。即使在微观层面上，它也已经被彻底化学清洁了。从一个遥远的洞穴传来了微弱的生物信号，但从这个距离来讲是不可能的。

我们目睹了几组机器人在空中巡逻。它们还没有对我们的存在作出反应。
texts.en:
This planet's atmosphere contains a staggering amount of antibacterial agents.

Sensors indicate zero signs of organic life in the immediate vicinity. Even on a microscopic level, it has been chemically removed. There is a faint biological reading emanating from a distant cavern, but from this range it is impossible to qualify.

Several clusters of robots have been witnessed patrolling the skies. They have not yet reacted to our presence.

texts.zh:
我们调查了一小群在空中巡逻的无人机。这些闪闪发光的金属球有一个正面的全息投影仪和一个定向推进器系统来保持它们的速度和高度。

我们在接近时保持了谨慎的距离，但无人机对我们的存在作出了反应。其中四只从集群中分离出来，改变了轨道来迎接我们，但速度相当缓慢。我们还没有触发警报，但接近的无人机的能力尚不清楚。
texts.en:
We investigated a small group of the drones patrolling the skies. These sparkling metallic balls have a front-facing holographic projector and a system of directional thrusters to maintain their speed and altitude.

We kept a cautious distance on approach, but the drones reacted to our presence regardless. Four of them splintered from the pack and changed trajectory to meet us, albeit at a rather slow pace. We have not triggered an alarm, but the approaching drones' capabilities are unknown.

texts.zh:
洞穴中与行星的其他任何地方都有截然不同的氛围。内部的墙壁覆盖着厚厚的太闲，土壤湿润而肥沃，充满了各种有机质。在一个隐蔽的壁龛里躺着一具干枯的鸟类遗骸。根据它的衣着和随身物品，我们认为它应该具有智能。考虑到星球的其他地方没有任何生物迹象，无论死活，所以这具尸体和周围的植物生命反而显得很异常。

我们发现了一架挂在钟乳石上的无人机。虽然仍在运行，但它无法移动。这架无人机显然是为了大量洒布未知的化学溶液而设计的。这台机器的许多内部部件都完好无损，很容易维修。
texts.en:
The cave has a markedly different atmosphere than the rest of the planet. The interior walls are heavy with moss and the soil is moist and rich with organic material. The desiccated remains of an avian creature lie in a secluded alcove. We assume the creature was intelligent based on its attire and belongings. Given that the rest of the planet is devoid of biological material, living or dead, this corpse and the surrounding plant life stand out as an anomaly.

Skewered on a stalactite, we discovered a drone. While still operational, it is unable to move. The drone was clearly designed to distribute an unknown chemical solution in large quantities. Many of the machine's internal components remain intact and could easily be repaired.

texts.zh:
四台无人机慢慢地靠近了裂隙探球，开始进行表面检测。其中一台无人机举起了右侧的炮管准备射击。

我们还没来得及反应，无人机就把压缩泡沫喷到了球体的一部分上。它的左炮管里又伸出了一个柔软而耐用的附件，开始擦洗船体上的碎屑和灰尘。其他无人机很快也效仿。

随着清洁工作的进行，其中一架无人机停下来，把它的附肢换成了一根精致的棉签。随着一声响亮的嘟嘟声，它收集了一个样本，然后转身离开了。在进一步清理之后，剩下的三架无人机朝同一个方向离开了。
texts.en:
The four drones slowly approached the Rift Sphere and examined its surface. One of the drones primed its right barrel, preparing to fire.

Before we could react, the drone squirted compressed foam over one section of the Sphere. From its left barrel, it revealed a limb with a soft-yet-durable attachment and started scrubbing away debris and dust from our hull. The other drones shortly followed suit.

As the cleaning progressed, one of the drones stopped and switched its attachment to a delicate swab. With a loud beep, it collected a sample and turned away. After some further cleaning, the three remaining drones departed in the same direction.

texts.zh:
作为安全预防措施，我们向巡逻无人机附近释放了一个短程电磁脉冲。它们马上就瘫痪了，从天空中坠落到了下方贫瘠的土地上。

强大的化学溶液从飞机残骸中泄漏出来，求救信号开始广播。如果我们相信我们是安全的，我们可以跟随求救信号到达预定的目的地。
texts.en:
As a security precaution, we released a short-range electromagnetic pulse in the vicinity of the patrolling drones. Deactivating immediately, they plummeted out of the sky, crashing onto the barren ground below.

Powerful chemical solutions leaked out of their wreckage, and a distress signal began to broadcast. If we believe we are safe, we can follow the distress signal toward its intended destination.

label.zh: 在它们的增援赶到之前赶紧逃。

texts.zh:
尸检没有发现严重的内伤或外伤。这种生物拥有鸟类的所有典型特征：中空的骨骼，角质覆盖的爪子，以及完整的羽毛。最可能的死亡原因是营养不良。

DNA分析表明，这个物种的免疫系统天生就很弱。特别的一点是，它的体内还含有抗菌溶液的沉积。
texts.en:
The autopsy revealed no serious internal or external wounds. The creature possessed all the typical features of an avian species: hollow bones, keratin-coated talons, and evidence of a full plumage. The most likely cause of death was malnutrition.

DNA analysis indicated that this species has (or had) a naturally weak immune system. Peculiarly, the body also contained trapped deposits of antibacterial solution.

label.zh: 取回那个鸟类然后研究研究这里发生了什么。
label.en: Retrieve the avian and determine what happened here.

texts.zh:
研究小组完成了武装准备之后，从钟乳石中救下了无人机。它利用一个紧凑的定向推进器系统，迅速开始在原地盘旋。随着一声有力的啪啪声，无人机向整个团队喷出了压缩的泡沫。从它的左桶里，露出一个柔软而耐用的附件，开始把我们擦洗干净。团队没有阻止它，因为无人机显然没有恶意。

突然，无人机停了下来。它的清洁装置被一个精致的棉签取代，用来收集污垢样本。它的全息投影仪显示了一个简单的视觉界面。

无人机对这些污垢进行分析和分类，作为新的清洁目标。似乎我们把一种外来物质引入了它的环境。
texts.en:
With the research team armed and ready, we freed the drone from the stalactite. It quickly began to hover in place using a compact system of directional thrusters. With a forceful splat, the drone squirted compressed foam over the entire team. From its left barrel, it revealed a soft-yet-durable attachment and proceeded to scrub us clean. The team allowed this, as the drone clearly meant no harm.

Suddenly the drone stopped. Its cleaning attachment was replaced by a delicate swab, which it used to collect a sample of dirt. Its holographic projector displayed a simple visual interface.

The dirt was analyzed and categorized by the drone as a new target for cleansing. It seems we have introduced a foreign material to its environment.

texts.zh:
我们跟随着无人机的路线回到了一处先进的设施中。这栋建筑在贫瘠的景观之上高耸入云，周围环绕着无人机，每架无人机都在不同的区域之间嗡嗡作响进行着不同的任务。

该设施的中心是科学设备和研究终端的连接点。奇怪的是，虽然大部分操作都是全自动的，但这个区域似乎是为人工研究而设计的；里面应该由有感知的生命来完成的任务，而不是无人机。
texts.en:
We traced the drones' route back to an advanced facility. Standing tall against the sterile landscape, the building was circled by drones, each buzzing between various zones to complete their tasks.

At the heart of the facility was a nexus of scientific equipment and research terminals. Oddly, while most of the operations were fully automated, this area seemed designed for manual research; tasks to be completed by sentient life as opposed to drones.

texts.zh:
只有一个结论：这些鸟类在长期的过度消毒运动中意外地导致了自己的灭绝。作为一个天生免疫系统较弱的物种，他们创造了清洁无人机来为公共和私人空间消毒，以减少疾病的传播。

然而，考虑到这颗星球的景观状况，我们可以假设清洁无人机在消灭本土生物方面做过头了，导致了星球上的有机生物多样性崩溃。简单地说，就是他们饿死了。随着尸体腐烂，无人驾驶飞机抹去了他们存在过的每一个痕迹。

至于洞穴里的遗骸，由于一架功能正常的无人机在该地区的存在，其他的无人机为了提高效率都没有再把注意力放在这里，因此植物的生命才得以保持完整。这只鸟类生物利用了这种编程功能上的漏洞才得以侥幸生存。不幸的是，洞穴里贫乏的植物不能无限期地维持下去。
texts.en:
There is only one conclusion: these avians accidentally drove themselves to extinction through a long-term campaign of over-sanitization. As a species with a naturally weak immune system, they created cleaning drones to disinfect public and private spaces in order to reduce the spread of disease.

However, given the state of the planet's landscape, we can assume that the cleaning drones went too far in exterminating native life, resulting in the destruction of organic biodiversity on the planet. Simply put, the population starved to death. As the bodies decomposed, the drones scrubbed away every trace of their existence.

As for the remains in the cave, the presence of a functional drone in the area likely diverted others for the sake of efficiency, leaving the plant life intact. The avian creature must have exploited this programming functionality in order to survive here. Unfortunately, the cave's meager plantlife could not sustain it indefinitely.

label.zh: 利用这个无人机的科技。
注入病毒瘫痪这个清洁网络。
label.en: Engineer a virus to disable the sanitation network.

label.zh: 让这台无人机充当个人研究助理。
label.en: Keep this drone as a personal research assistant.

texts.zh:
这间实验室已经很多年无人问津。与星球上的其他地方不同，这里布满了灰尘和污垢。从发光显示器收集的信息来看，无人机是完全自主的清洁设备。它们被分配到指定区域巡逻并进行消毒，在电力或化学品不足时返回设施。它们由各种可再生能源提供动力，清洗液从空气中的蒸汽和地下水中回收，创造了一个几乎可以无限运行的自我维持网络。

对我们的船体进行过采样的那台无人机独自在实验室里盘旋，它的全息投影仪被照亮，显示一个简单的视觉界面。它从裂隙探球中移除的物质已被分析，并归类为新的清洁目标。

我们推断，这些自动清洁无人机的创造者要么离开了这个星球，或者已经发生了灭绝。他们存在过的所有生物痕迹都被彻底擦洗干净了。
texts.en:
This lab has been left untouched for years. Unlike the rest of the planet, it is caked in dust and grime. Information gleaned from the illuminated displays confirm that the drones are fully autonomous cleaning devices. They are assigned to patrol a designated area, sterilize it, and return to the facility when low on power or chemicals. Powered by a variety of renewable energy sources, their cleaning fluid is recycled from airborne vapor and groundwater, creating a self-sustaining network that can function almost indefinitely.

The drone that sampled our hull hovers alone in the laboratory with its holographic projector illuminated, displaying a simple visual interface. The substance it removed from the Rift Sphere has already been analyzed and categorized as a new cleaning target.

We theorize that the creators of the autonomous cleaning drones either left the planet or have gone extinct. Every biological trace of their existence has been scrubbed away.

label.zh: 记录并研究这个清洁基础设施。
label.en: Document and study the sanitary infrastructure.

texts.zh:
我们在这台自动化设施上发现了各种优势和技术创新，可以为我们自己的星球带来更好的卫生和无人机管理。

我们可以利用现有的优质基础设施，推行类似的清洁制度。

此外，研究这个物种在全球范围内的努力，也能提高我们对个体思维如何能够有效合作的认识。
texts.en:
We noted the various strengths and technological innovations of the automated facility, with the intention of bringing improved sanitation and drone management to our own planets.

We will be able to use our existing superior infrastructure to implement a similar cleaning regime.

Furthermore, studying planet-wide efforts by this species has improved our insight into how individual minds are able to collaborate effectively.

texts.zh:
我们在这台自动化设施上发现了各种优势和技术创新，可以为我们自己的星球带来更好的卫生和无人机管理。

我们可以利用现有的优质基础设施，推行类似的清洁制度。
texts.en:
We noted the various strengths and technological innovations of the automated facility, with the intention of bringing improved sanitation and drone management to our own planets.

We will be able to use our existing superior infrastructure to implement a similar cleaning regime.

texts.zh:
我们能安全地关闭这座自动清洁设施，并召回它的所有无人机。一切都还保留着可以工作的状态，以便原住民返回时使用。为了考古学家工作之便我们才将其关闭。

然而，我还从设施的电力储存中收集了大量的能量。
texts.en:
We were able to safely shut down the automated sanitization facility and recall all of its drones. Everything was left in full working order in case of return by the native inhabitants. Failing that, for the benefit of archaeologists.

However, we managed to harvest a significant amount of energy from the facility's power stores.

texts.zh: 我们轻易地关闭了自动消毒设施内的系统，直到无人机网络失效。我们汲取了所有的发电机、电源存储和辅助电池，从而收集了大量的能量。
texts.en: We haphazardly shut down systems within the automated sanitization facility until the network of drones had been disabled. We drained every last generator, power store, and ancillary battery - harvesting a significant amount of energy.

texts.zh:
我们能安全地关闭这座自动清洁设施，并召回它的所有无人机。一切都还保留着可以工作的状态，以便原住民返回时使用。

然而，我还从设施的电力储存中收集了大量的能量。
texts.en:
We were able to safely shut down the automated sanitization facility and recall all of its drones. Everything was left in full working order in case of return by the native inhabitants.

However, we managed to harvest a significant amount of energy from the facility's power stores.

texts.zh: 担心有大量的这种自动无人机淹没我们，我们决定避开任何危险升级的可能性此外，这颗贫瘠的星球似乎没有提供什么研究的可能性。我们在离开时从被摧毁的无人机上收集了一些资源。
texts.en: Faced with the risk of a huge number of these autonomous drones swarming us, we decided to avoid any chance of escalating danger. Furthermore, the sterile planet seemed to offer little in the way of research possibilities. We did manage to collect some resources from the destroyed drones as we departed.

texts.zh: 我们取回的消毒无人机可以逆向工程用于帮助我们的殖民工程。它可以用来编目当地动植物群系的细节，帮助我们的殖民者更熟悉新边境的环境。
texts.en: The sanitation drone we have recovered can be reverse engineered to assist in our colonization efforts. It can be repurposed to catalog the minutiae of native flora and fauna to help our colonists familiarize themselves with the terrain of new frontiers.

texts.zh:
我们编写了一个电脑病毒，并将其上载到修复后的清洁无人机的网络中。一旦病毒回到其基地就会开始传播，并最终使这个伪声基础设施瘫痪。

也许这个星球最终会从化学杀菌中恢复过来，新的生命将从这个孤立的洞穴中进化出来。
texts.en:
We engineered a potent computer virus and uploaded it to the repaired cleaning drone's network. Once it returns to its home base, the virus should spread and eventually render the sanitization infrastructure inactive.

Perhaps this planet will eventually recover from its chemical sterilization and new life will evolve from this isolated cave.

texts.zh:
经过一些小的调整，这架翻新的卫生无人机将成为一名出色的研究助手。它具有收集生物样本的能力，执行高灵巧的任务，以及独立飞行的能力，作为我们研究团队的一部分，它有很大的潜力。

我们断开了无人机与卫生网络的连接，并安装了新的程序来补充其现有的功能。在它与[explorer.GetName]一同工作的过程中，我们将继续跟踪它的表现。
texts.en:
After some minor adjustments, this refurbished sanitation drone will make an excellent research assistant. With the ability to collect biological samples, perform high dexterity tasks, and the power of independent flight, it has great potential as part of our research team.

We disconnected the drone from the sanitation network and installed new features to complement its existing capabilities. We will continue to track its performance as it works alongside [explorer.GetName].
